item.title: Missouri may allow 5-year car registration soon
item.description: Missouri drivers with newer vehicles could soon have the option to register their cars for five years at a time instead of just one or two years, under legislation unanimously backed Monday by the Missouri House.

item.title: Man sentenced for abusing teen he met on Instagram
item.description: A man appeared in federal court on Wednesday and was sentenced for sexually abusing a 15-year-old girl he contacted through Instagram.

item.title: Cleanup continues months after Florissant explosion
item.description: Cleanup and repairs are progressing in parts of a Florissant neighborhood months after an explosion damaged 20 homes, though some residents remain displaced.

item.title: Applebee's closing restaurants in Missouri, other states
item.description: Applebee's fans in several U.S. cities will no longer be "eatin' good in the neighborhood."

item.title: Webster University unveils extreme weather photo exhibit
item.description: The exhibit showcases dramatic scenes of wildfires, severe storms, and melting polar landscapes, highlighting both the beauty and intensity of extreme weather.

item.title: Matt Holliday's standout Oklahoma home with baseball field hits market for $12 million
item.description: Imagine a baseball field in your own backyard. Now add a two-story pool, an indoor pickleball court and a five-bedroom mansion loaded with luxury touches. That's exactly what former St. Louis Cardinals star Matt Holliday is offering with his standout Oklahoma home, now on the market for $12 million.
